content: CCM aims to divide characters (other than $c_t$) into a positive community and a negative set. We define this positive community as characters that are densely connected internally to $c_t$ within the character space, and the negative set as the remaining characters. We can then sample dialogue from characters in the negative set to act as the distractors (essentially negative samples) during LSRM training.
